name: cri_adxi_initialize_spu
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Optionally calls sceSdInit(SD_INIT_COLD) according to sdinit, then sets both cores' master volumes to 0x3FFF.

name: cri_adxi_main_worker
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Initializes SPU and CRI subsystems using configured core/thread priorities; repeatedly services CRI work then calls vblank import ordinal 5 at image 0xC660.

name: cri_adxi_initialize_module
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Parses thpri/spucore/sdinit/pthpri/dthpri/debug arguments; initializes SIF services and creates/starts main worker (image 0x88), stack 0x800, configured priority. Returns 2 after start, 1 if thread creation fails.

name: cri_adxi_initialize_subsystems
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Calls initialization for playback manager, stream/RPC transport and related CRI subsystems.

name: cri_adxi_service_subsystems
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Main-worker service wrapper calls image 0x11B4.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_dispatch
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. RPC commands 2/3 create/destroy a DTX work context. Commands 0x400..0x43F invoke handler[command-0x400] with registered context, RPC buffer and byte length/4; returns the same RPC buffer.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_worker
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Sets the RPC queue to the current thread, registers service ID from image 0xD8F4 (0x90000200), handler cri_adxi_rpc_dispatch and buffer image 0xE7C0; marks readiness then enters RPC loop.

name: cri_adxi_create_dtx_work
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Allocates an unused one of 16 0x44-byte DTX contexts by ID; validates EE work alignment 64, IOP work alignment 32 and byte length multiple 64, retains EE/IOP addresses and work size minus 0x40.

name: cri_adxi_service_dtx_work
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Uses sequence counter at work-tail +0x3C to detect inbound work, invokes inbound callback on IOP work region and outgoing callback on same region, advances counter and submits one SIF DMA descriptor (IOP address, EE address, work length).

name: cri_adxi_initialize_rpc
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. First reference clears 64 handler pointers and contexts, creates/starts cri_adxi_rpc_worker with stack 0x800 and priority from image 0xD900 (initial 0x30).

name: cri_adxi_register_rpc_handler
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Writes handler and context into parallel 64-slot tables at image 0xE6C0 and 0xE5C0.

name: cri_adxi_service_all_dtx_work
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Services each active one of 16 0x44-byte DTX contexts under the CRI lock.

name: cri_adxi_receive_playback_controls
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. DTX ID 1 inbound callback reads header count then 0x10-byte records (16-bit operation, IOPRNA handle, two parameter words). Operations start/stop or update PSM channel count, frequency, channel gain, pan, playback flags and other PSM scalar state. No file/member/bank/cue lookup in this dispatch.

name: cri_adxi_playback_transfer_outbound_callback
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Outbound DTX ID1 callback registered by cri_adxi_initialize_playback_transfer loops16 times and writes count0; it emits no status records.

name: cri_adxi_service_remote_playback
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Visits active one of 16 0x1C-byte IOPRNA rows, drains queued stream chunks when requested, then services DTX work.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_create_remote_playback
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler 0x408 allocates one of 16 0x1C-byte IOPRNA rows, copies channel count and stream handles from RPC buffer, creates PSM, configures playback and returns the row handle in buffer word 0.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_destroy_remote_playback
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x409 destroys PSM handle stored at IOPRNA+0xC, clears handle and marks row inactive.

name: cri_adxi_initialize_playback_transfer
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x40A reinitializes PSM using3 RPC words, opens DTX ID1 and registers cri_adxi_receive_playback_controls/cri_adxi_playback_transfer_outbound_callback (emits count0).

name: cri_adxi_register_remote_playback_handlers
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. First reference registers IOPRNA handlers for commands 0x408..0x412 and initializes their subsystems.

name: cri_adxi_create_playback_manager
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. PSM_Create validates SPU core 0/1 and nonnegative channel count, creates per-channel slot/buffer/ring objects, binds supplied stream handles, initializes gain/frequency/flags and returns an active PSM handle; no character or archive selector input.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_create_ring_stream
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x420 forwards3 constructor words to locked ring-stream allocator and returns handle.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_create_memory_stream
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x421 forwards2 constructor words to locked memory-stream allocator and returns handle.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_create_unit_stream
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x422 forwards3 constructor words to stream allocator (retains first byte, backing address and count/16), returns handle.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_get_stream_chunk
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x426 calls stream virtual method+0x18 with handle, selector and requested count; returns2-word data-address/byte-count chunk.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_unget_stream_chunk
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x427 builds data-address/byte-count chunk from RPC words2/3 and calls stream virtual method+0x1C with selector.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_put_stream_chunk
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x428 builds data-address/byte-count chunk from RPC words2/3 and calls stream virtual method+0x20 with selector.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_get_stream_count
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x429 calls stream virtual method+0x24 with handle and selector, returns scalar count.

name: cri_adxi_register_remote_stream_handlers
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. First reference registers 11 stream handlers for commands 0x420..0x42A.

name: cri_adxi_receive_stream_chunks
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. DTX ID 0 inbound callback reads header count and 0x10-byte records; type byte 0 invokes the underlying stream's PutChunk method with selector 1 and record words +8/+0xC (data address and byte count). Record +4 identifies the SJX handle; this path contains no file/member/bank/cue selection.

name: cri_adxi_collect_stream_chunks
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. DTX ID 0 outbound callback visits 32 active 0x14-byte SJX records and collects up to 128 GetChunk results, recording type 0, selector byte, stream token, auxiliary 16-bit value, data address and byte count into 0x10-byte records.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_create_notification_pair
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Handler0x400 allocates one of32 0x14-byte SJX rows, retains IOP stream handle, EE stream identifier, adjusted selector and EE pair token; returns IOP pair handle.

name: cri_adxi_initialize_stream_transfer
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. Opens DTX ID 0 and registers cri_adxi_receive_stream_chunks and cri_adxi_collect_stream_chunks as inbound/outbound callbacks.

name: cri_adxi_register_transfer_handlers
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. First reference registers handlers for commands 0x400..0x403.

name: cri_adxi_rpc_service_id
comment: NUN3 CRI_ADXI.IRX image address, relocated IOP base not established. RPC server ID 0x90000200 used by cri_adxi_rpc_worker.
